***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maharashtra]]

*[[Politics of Australia]]
**[[2022 South Australian state election]]
***Preliminary election results show [[Peter Malinauskas]] and his [[Australian Labor Party (South Australian Branch)|Labor Party]] winning a majority. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-03-19/sa-votes-south-australia-state-election-2022-live-blog/100917538 (ABC News Australia)]

*[[Serdar Berdimuhamedow]] is sworn-in as [[President of Turkmenistan]], succeeding his father [[Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedow]]. [https://yenisafak.com/en/world/serdar-berdimuhamedov-sworn-in-as-turkmenistans-new-president-3592007 (''Yeni Şafak'')]
